Tahukah anda?Did you know?Perpustakaan ini dinamakan sempena Tun Seri Lanang, Bendahara Johor yang dikaitkan dengan penyusunan Sulalatus Salatin (Sejarah Melayu) pada 1612. Today we organise literature in a building that carries his name.
OBJEKTIF · OBJECTIVE

Memperkasakan kemahiran mencari, menganalisis dan mengaplikasikan literatur AI secara sistematik demi penyelidikan yang lebih berkualiti dan berimpak tinggi.Strengthen skills to search, analyse and apply literature systematically with AI, for higher-quality, higher-impact research.

VBE · Pendidikan Berasaskan NilaiValues-Based Education

Iman · Ilmu · AmalFaith · Knowledge · Practice

Setiap teknik dikaitkan dengan satu nilai: amanah (sitasi tepat), integriti (dedahkan AI), kebertanggungjawaban (manusia membuat keputusan akhir).Every technique is tied to a value: trustworthiness (accurate citations), integrity (disclose AI), accountability (humans make the final call).

KonektivismeConnectivism · Siemens (2005)

Ilmu hidup dalam rangkaianKnowledge lives in networks

Literatur ialah rangkaian sitasi, pengarang dan idea. Kemahiran utama: tahu di mana mencari dan melihat hubungan antara nod.Literature is a network of citations, authors and ideas. The core skill: knowing where to look and seeing connections between nodes.

KelajuanSpeed
12 → 2

Sistem otto-SR menghasilkan semula dan mengemas kini 12 ulasan Cochrane dalam 2 hari, anggaran ±12 tahun-kerja manusia. Sensitiviti saringan 96.7% berbanding 81.7% saringan dua manusia.The otto-SR system reproduced and updated 12 Cochrane reviews in 2 days, an estimated ~12 human work-years. Screening sensitivity 96.7% vs 81.7% for dual human screening.

Cao, C., … Bobrovitz, N. (2025). Automation of systematic reviews with large language models. medRxiv (pracetak, belum dinilai rakan / preprint, not peer-reviewed). doi:10.1101/2025.06.13.25329541

RisikoRisk
55% · 18%

Rujukan rekaan dalam tinjauan literatur yang ditulis GPT-3.5 dan GPT-4. Pada 2026, ejen deep research masih menghasilkan 3–13% URL sitasi yang tidak pernah wujud.Fabricated references in literature reviews written by GPT-3.5 and GPT-4. In 2026, deep-research agents still produce 3–13% citation URLs that never existed.

Walters, W. H., & Wilder, E. I. (2023). Scientific Reports, 13, 14045. doi:10.1038/s41598-023-41032-5 · Rao, D., Wong, E., & Callison-Burch, C. (2026). arXiv:2604.03173. arxiv.org/abs/2604.03173

VBE · AMANAH

Garis Panduan GenAI UKM (2025): pelajar kekal bertanggungjawab sepenuhnya atas semua kandungan, dan setiap sitasi mesti disemak sendiri dengan sumber asal.UKM GenAI Guideline (2025): the student remains fully accountable for all content, and every citation must be personally checked against the original source.

Konsep 1.1 · Mulakan dengan tujuanConcept 1.1 · Start from the purpose

Jenis kajian menentukan tahap ketelitian, dan alat AI yang sesuaiThe review type sets the rigour, and which AI tools fit

TujuanPurpose

Gambaran luas dan latar konsep, contohnya Bab 2 tesis atau artikel konsep.Broad overview and conceptual background, e.g. a thesis Chapter 2 or a concept paper.

KetelitianRigour

Fleksibel; tiada protokol wajib. Risiko berat sebelah pemilihan tinggi, jadi nyatakan strategi carian.Flexible; no mandatory protocol. High selection-bias risk, so state your search strategy.

Alat AI sesuaiAI tools that fit

Consensus · Elicit · NotebookLM · ResearchRabbit

TujuanPurpose

Memetakan saiz dan jenis bukti dalam bidang baharu; kenal pasti jurang.Map the extent and type of evidence in an emerging field; identify gaps.

KetelitianRigour

Rangka Arksey & O'Malley; laporan PRISMA-ScR. Tiada penilaian kualiti wajib.Arksey & O'Malley framework; PRISMA-ScR reporting. No mandatory quality appraisal.

Alat AI sesuaiAI tools that fit

Scopus AI · Litmaps · ASReview · Elicit

TujuanPurpose

Menjawab soalan khusus dengan semua bukti yang layak; boleh disertai meta-analisis.Answer a focused question with all eligible evidence; may include meta-analysis.

KetelitianRigour

Protokol berdaftar, saringan dua penilai, PRISMA 2020 + PRISMA-S. Tahap tertinggi.Registered protocol, dual screening, PRISMA 2020 + PRISMA-S. Highest rigour.

Alat AI sesuaiAI tools that fit

Rayyan · ASReview · Covidence · Elicit Systematic Review

TujuanPurpose

Menggabungkan kajian empirikal dan teoretikal untuk membina kerangka baharu.Combine empirical and theoretical work to build a new framework.

KetelitianRigour

Sederhana–tinggi; kekuatan pada sintesis kritis (Snyder, 2019).Moderate–high; strength lies in critical synthesis (Snyder, 2019).

Alat AI sesuaiAI tools that fit

NotebookLM · scite · Gemini / Claude (pengkritik)

TujuanPurpose

Menganalisis corak penerbitan: pengarang, negara, rangkaian kata kunci.Analyse publication patterns: authors, countries, keyword networks.

KetelitianRigour

Tinggi pada data; bergantung kepada eksport Scopus/WoS yang bersih.High on data; depends on clean Scopus/WoS exports.

Alat AI sesuaiAI tools that fit

VOSviewer · Bibliometrix · Scopus AI · Gemini (kod R/Python)

💡
Pro tipPro tipTak pasti jenis kajian? Tanya diri: perlukan SEMUA bukti, atau bukti yang MENCUKUPI? Semua → sistematik. Mencukupi → naratif atau skop.Not sure which type? Ask yourself: do I need ALL the evidence, or ENOUGH evidence? All → systematic. Enough → narrative or scoping.

Konsep 1.2 · Gambaran besarConcept 1.2 · The big picture

Enam peringkat, enam titik semak manusiaSix stages, six human checkpoints

Peranan AIAI's role

Mempercepat langkah berulang: sinonim, saringan awal, isi jadual, draf struktur.Speeds up repetitive steps: synonyms, first-pass screening, table filling, outline drafts.

Peranan andaYour role

Menetapkan soalan, kriteria, tafsiran dan hujah. Keputusan akhir di tangan penyelidik.Set the question, criteria, interpretation and argument. The final decision is the researcher's.

PrinsipPrinciple

Kenyataan bersama Cochrane, Campbell, JBI & CEE (2025): AI digunakan dengan pengawasan manusia; penyelidik bertanggungjawab sepenuhnya.Joint statement by Cochrane, Campbell, JBI & CEE (2025): AI is used with human oversight; researchers remain ultimately responsible.

Flemyng, E., Noel-Storr, A., Macura, B., et al. (2025). Position statement on AI use in evidence synthesis. JBI Evidence Synthesis, 23(11), 2162–2166. doi:10.11124/JBIES-25-00480

Konsep 1.3 · Alat pendampingConcept 1.3 · Companion tools

Pilih alat ikut tugas, bukan ikut popularitiChoose tools by task, not popularity

A · Enjin carian akademik AIAI academic search

Scopus AI · Elicit · Consensus · Semantic Scholar

Mencari dalam pangkalan kertas sebenar. Jawapan berpaut kepada sumber.Search a corpus of real papers. Answers link to sources.

Risiko halusinasi: rendahHallucination risk: low
B · Peta rangkaian sitasiCitation-network maps

ResearchRabbit · Litmaps · Connected Papers

Bermula dari kertas benih, menemui kerja berkaitan melalui sitasi. Konektivisme dalam amalan.Start from seed papers and discover related work through citations. Connectivism in practice.

Risiko: rendahRisk: low
C · Pembantu dokumenDocument assistants

NotebookLM · SciSpace · scite

Bertanya kepada PDF anda sendiri. Jawapan berpaut kepada petikan dalam dokumen.Ask questions of your own PDFs. Answers cite passages in the documents.

Risiko: sederhanaRisk: moderate
D · LLM umumGeneral LLMs

Gemini · ChatGPT · Claude · Copilot

Hebat untuk sinonim, struktur, kritikan. Jangan jadikan sumber rujukan.Great for synonyms, structure, critique. Never use as a source of references.

Risiko rujukan: tinggiReference risk: high

Gunakan akaun UKM: Scopus dan Web of Science melalui laman PTSL, Gemini melalui Google Workspace UKM (data tidak digunakan untuk latihan model, semak terma semasa). Untuk literatur tempatan: MyCite dan MyJurnal.Use your UKM account: Scopus and Web of Science via the PTSL portal, Gemini through UKM Google Workspace (check current terms on data use). Tahukah anda? · 170 tahun mencariDid you know? · 170 years of searching

Sebelum Scopus, ada laci kad. Ideanya masih sama.Before Scopus there were card drawers. The idea hasn't changed.

Wooden Card Catalog Furniture · MarkBuckawicki · CC0 · Wikimedia Commons
1854

George Boole menerbitkan The Laws of Thought: algebra di sebalik AND, OR, NOT.George Boole publishes The Laws of Thought: the algebra behind AND, OR, NOT.

1955

Eugene Garfield mencadangkan indeks sitasi dalam Science: idea asal peta sitasi.Eugene Garfield proposes a citation index in Science: the origin of citation maps. doi:10.1126/science.122.3159.108

1964

Science Citation Index diterbitkan: carian sitasi bercetak.The Science Citation Index is published: citation search in print.

2004

Scopus dan Google Scholar dilancarkan pada bulan yang sama: November 2004.Scopus and Google Scholar launch in the same month: November 2004.

2022

ChatGPT dilancarkan (30 Nov): soalan bahasa biasa menjadi antara muka carian.ChatGPT launches (30 Nov): plain-language questions become a search interface.

2026

Ejen penyelidikan merancang, mencari dan memantau sendiri. Boole masih di dalamnya.Research agents plan, search and monitor on their own. Boole is still inside.

Konsep 1.4 · Soalan yang baik = carian yang baikConcept 1.4 · Good question = good search

Pecahkan soalan kepada blok konsep sebelum bertanya kepada AIBreak the question into concept blocks before asking AI

Contoh tempatan: "Bagaimanakah tekanan kewangan mempengaruhi kesejahteraan psikologi belia B40 di bandar Malaysia?"Local example: "How does financial stress affect the psychological well-being of urban B40 youth in Malaysia?"

P · Population

Belia 18–30, isi rumah B40, bandarYouth 18–30, B40 households, urban

youth* · "young adult*" · "emerging adult*" · belia

E · Exposure

Tekanan kewangan / kos sara hidupFinancial stress / cost of living

"financial stress" · "economic hardship" · "low income" · B40

O · Outcome

Kesejahteraan psikologiPsychological well-being

"psychological well-being" · "mental health" · "life satisfaction" · kesejahteraan

S · Sample

Ibu tunggal B40, Lembah KlangB40 single mothers, Klang Valley

PI · Phenomenon

Pengalaman mengurus tekanan kewanganExperience of managing financial stress

D · Design

interview* · "focus group*" · phenomenolog*

E · Evaluation

"coping" · "lived experience*" · resilien*

R · Research type

qualitative · "mixed method*"

P · Population

Pelajar universiti B40B40 university students

I · Intervention

Program literasi kewanganFinancial-literacy programme

C · Comparison

Tiada program / program biasaNo programme / usual practice

O · Outcome

Tekanan psikologi (DASS-21)Psychological distress (DASS-21)

Pro tipPro tipUji setiap blok konsep secara berasingan di Scopus dahulu. Jika satu blok memberi 0 rekod, masalahnya di situ, bukan pada AI.Test each concept block on its own in Scopus first. If one block returns 0 records, that block is the problem, not the AI.

Demo 1 · Dari soalan ke rentetan carianDemo 1 · From question to search string

Minta AI cadangkan sinonim; anda yang menguji di ScopusAsk AI for synonyms; you test them in Scopus

✦Gemini · UKM Workspaceemulasiemulated
AndaYou
PROMPT
Anda pustakawan penyelidikan. Bina rentetan carian Boolean untuk Scopus (TITLE-ABS-KEY) bagi soalan: "Bagaimanakah tekanan kewangan mempengaruhi kesejahteraan psikologi belia B40 di bandar Malaysia?" Guna kerangka PEO. Beri 3–5 sinonim setiap blok, guna tanda petik untuk frasa dan * untuk pemangkasan. Jangan senaraikan sebarang artikel.You are a research librarian. Build a Boolean search string for Scopus (TITLE-ABS-KEY) for the question: "How does financial stress affect the psychological well-being of urban B40 youth in Malaysia?" Use the PEO framework. Give 3–5 synonyms per block, use quotes for phrases and * for truncation. Do not list any articles.
Gemini
Berikut rentetan tiga blok (P AND E AND O), dengan penapis negara dan tahun. Uji setiap blok secara berasingan dahulu untuk melihat jumlah rekod.Here is a three-block string (P AND E AND O), with country and year filters. Test each block separately first to see record counts.
scopus · output dijangkaexpected output
TITLE-ABS-KEY ( ( youth* OR "young adult*" OR "emerging adult*" )  AND ( "financial stress" OR "economic hardship" OR "low income" OR b40 OR povert* )  AND ( "psychological well-being" OR "mental health" OR "life satisfaction" OR depress* ) )AND TITLE-ABS-KEY ( malaysia* )AND PUBYEAR > 2015AND ( LIMIT-TO ( DOCTYPE , "ar" ) )

Prompt susulanFollow-up prompt
PROMPT
Terjemahkan rentetan tadi kepada istilah Bahasa Melayu untuk carian di MyCite dan Google Scholar. Kekalkan struktur P AND E AND O. Cadangkan juga istilah yang lazim dalam jurnal tempatan seperti Akademika dan e-Bangi.Translate the previous string into Malay terms for searching MyCite and Google Scholar. Keep the P AND E AND O structure. Also suggest terms common in local journals such as Akademika and e-Bangi.

Kenapa? Literatur tempatan berbahasa Melayu sering tercicir jika hanya carian bahasa Inggeris digunakan.Why? Malay-language local literature is often missed by English-only searches.

PROMPT
Tukar rentetan Scopus tadi ke sintaks Web of Science (TS=). Gunakan operator proksimiti NEAR/3 untuk "financial" dan "stress". Terangkan setiap perubahan dalam satu baris supaya saya boleh melaporkannya ikut PRISMA-S.Convert the Scopus string to Web of Science syntax (TS=). Perspektif berbeza, rentetan berbezaDifferent lens, different string

Kajian kualitatif (SPIDER) menambah blok reka bentuk dan menukar hasil kepada pengalaman. Kajian kuantitatif menambah blok kaedah seperti survey atau regression.A qualitative review (SPIDER) adds a design block and turns outcomes into experiences. A quantitative review adds a methods block such as survey or regression.

PROMPT
Ubah rentetan ini untuk sintesis bukti kualitatif menggunakan SPIDER. Tambah blok reka bentuk (temu bual, kumpulan fokus, fenomenologi) dan blok penilaian (pengalaman hidup, daya tindak).Adapt this string for a qualitative evidence synthesis using SPIDER. Add a design block (interviews, focus groups, phenomenology) and an evaluation block (lived experience, coping).
scopus · SPIDER
TITLE-ABS-KEY ( ( "single mother*" OR "lone mother*" OR "female-headed household*" )  AND ( "financial stress" OR "economic hardship" OR povert* )  AND ( interview* OR "focus group*" OR phenomenolog* OR qualitative )  AND ( "lived experience*" OR coping OR resilien* ) )AND TITLE-ABS-KEY ( malaysia* )

🔎Sejauh manakah ketepatan model bahasa besar dalam saringan abstrak untuk kajian sistematik?How accurate are large language models at screening abstracts for systematic reviews?
Ringkasan · keyakinan sederhanaSummary · moderate confidence

LLM terkini mencapai sensitiviti tinggi (0.85–0.94) dalam saringan, tetapi spesifisiti berbeza ikut model [1].Recent LLMs reach high sensitivity (0.85–0.94) in screening, but specificity varies by model [1].

Prestasi bergantung kepada prompt dan bahasa; pengesahan manusia masih disyorkan [2].Performance depends on prompts and language; human validation is still recommended [2].

Saringan pembelajaran aktif mengurangkan beban kerja dengan menyusun rekod paling relevan dahulu [3].Active-learning screening cuts workload by ranking the most relevant records first [3].

⚠ Jurang: sedikit kajian dalam sains sosial bukan bahasa InggerisGap: few studies in non-English social science

S4 · Status

Rentetan carian yang baik pun begitu: diulang-alik sehingga sebati.Tarik means "pull": the tea is poured back and forth from a height to cool it and build the froth. A good search string works the same way: refine it back and forth until it is just right.

Kajian sistematik pernah bermaksud kertas, pen dan kesabaranSystematic reviews used to mean paper, pens and patience

Students in the Reading room 1960s · pengarang tidak diketahuiunknown author · Domain awamPublic domain · Wikimedia Commons
1993

Cochrane Collaboration ditubuhkan, sempena nama Archie Cochrane yang menyeru ringkasan bukti yang teratur dan dikemas kini.The Cochrane Collaboration is founded, named after Archie Cochrane, who called for organised, up-to-date summaries of evidence.

DuluThen

Dua penilai membaca setiap abstrak bercetak, dan bertemu untuk menyelesaikan percanggahan.Two reviewers read every printed abstract, then met to resolve disagreements.

KiniNow

Alat menyusun dan mencadang; dua manusia masih membuat keputusan. Prinsipnya tidak berubah.Tools rank and suggest; two humans still decide. The principle hasn't changed.

Konsep 2.2 · SaringanConcept 2.2 · Screening

Pembelajaran aktif menyusun; LLM menilai. Kedua-duanya diaudit manusia.Active learning ranks; LLMs judge. Both are audited by humans.

A · Pembelajaran aktifActive learning · ASReview, Rayyan

Anda tetap membuat setiap keputusan; AI hanya mengubah urutan supaya rekod relevan muncul awal. Ketelusan tinggi, sesuai untuk tesis.You still make every decision; AI only changes the order so relevant records appear early. Highly transparent, thesis-friendly.

B · Saringan LLM berpromptPrompted LLM screening · Gemini, GPT, Claude

LLM membuat keputusan pertama dengan alasan. Pantas, tetapi mesti dikalibrasi pada sampel berlabel dan dilaporkan (alat, versi, tarikh).The LLM makes a first decision with reasons. Fast, but must be calibrated on a labelled sample and reported (tool, version, date).

van de Schoot, R., et al. (2021). An open source machine learning framework for efficient and transparent systematic reviews. Nature Machine Intelligence, 3, 125–133. doi:10.1038/s42256-020-00287-7 · Ouzzani, M., et al. (2016). Rayyan. Syst Rev, 5, 210. doi:10.1186/s13643-016-0384-4

Fakta 2.3 · Bukti 2025Fact 2.3 · 2025 evidence

Tiada model terbaik untuk semua; pilih ikut risiko yang anda sanggup tanggungNo model is best at everything; choose by the risk you can tolerate

Saringan teks penuh, 4 LLM (Oami et al., 2025)Full-text screening, 4 LLMs (Oami et al., 2025)
Sensitiviti (tidak terlepas kajian)Sensitivity (don't miss studies) Spesifisiti (kurang positif palsu)Specificity (fewer false positives)
BacaanReading

Gemini 1.5 Pro & Claude 3.5 Sonnet cenderung sensitiviti; GPT-4o & Llama 3.3 cenderung spesifisiti.Gemini 1.5 Pro & Claude 3.5 Sonnet lean to sensitivity; GPT-4o & Llama 3.3 lean to specificity.

ImplikasiImplication

Untuk kajian sistematik, terlepas kajian lebih mahal daripada membaca lebih. Utamakan sensitiviti, kemudian manusia menapis positif palsu.For systematic reviews, missing a study costs more than reading extra. Prioritise sensitivity, then humans filter false positives.

Bila guna?When to use?

Kajian naratif atau skop dengan ribuan rekod, apabila masa terhad dan terlepas sedikit kajian boleh diterima. Rekod 3 kini akan EXCLUDE (I2 tiada): lihat kos ketegasan.Narrative or scoping reviews with thousands of records, when time is short and missing a few studies is acceptable. Record 3 now becomes EXCLUDE (I2 missing): the cost of strictness.

LLM memahami BM dengan baik, tetapi semak padanan istilah tempatan (contoh: "mahasiswa" = belia?). Keputusan definisi itu milik anda.LLMs handle Malay well, but check local term mapping (e.g. is "mahasiswa" = youth?). That definitional call is yours.

PROMPT
Gunakan Teori Tekanan Keluarga (Family Stress Model) sebagai kerangka. Petakan setiap dapatan kepada komponen: tekanan ekonomi → tekanan emosi → konflik keluarga → kesejahteraan. Tandakan dapatan yang tidak sesuai dengan mana-mana komponen.Use the Family Stress Model as the framework. Map each finding to its components: economic pressure → emotional distress → family conflict → well-being. Flag findings that fit no component.
Kenapa deduktif?Why deductive?

Sesuai apabila tesis anda berlandaskan teori tertentu. Dapatan yang "tidak muat" menjadi sumbangan teori anda.Fits when your thesis rests on a specific theory. Findings that "don't fit" become your theoretical contribution.

PROMPT
Bertindak sebagai penilai jurnal yang skeptikal. Untuk setiap tema saya, nyatakan (a) bukti yang lemah, (b) penjelasan alternatif, (c) kajian dalam senarai saya yang bercanggah. Jangan memuji.Act as a sceptical journal reviewer. For each of my themes, state (a) weak evidence, (b) alternative explanations, (c) studies in my list that contradict it. Do not praise.

Integriti: gunakan AI untuk mencabar tafsiran anda, bukan mengesahkannya.Integrity: use AI to challenge your interpretation, not to confirm it.

Konsep 3.1 · Kualiti kajian literaturConcept 3.1 · What makes a review good

Ringkasan berkata "siapa kata apa"; sintesis berkata "apa maknanya"A summary says "who said what"; a synthesis says "what it means"

Anatomi perenggan sintesisAnatomy of a synthesis paragraph
① DakwaanClaimAyat topik berasaskan konsepConcept-based topic sentence
② Bukti bergabungPooled evidenceBeberapa kajian dalam satu ayatSeveral studies in one sentence
③ PerbandinganComparisonDi mana kajian berbeza, dan kenapaWhere studies differ, and why
④ Jurang & implikasiGap & implicationApa yang belum diketahuiWhat is not yet known
Kajian A (2021) mendapati tekanan kewangan berkait dengan kemurungan dalam kalangan belia di Kuala Lumpur. Kajian B (2022) menemu bual 18 belia di Kelantan dan mendapati keluarga penting. Kajian C (2023) mendapati kos sara hidup mengurangkan kepuasan hidup. Kajian E (2024) mengkaji bantuan tunai.Study A (2021) found financial stress was linked to depression among youth in Kuala Lumpur. Study B (2022) interviewed 18 youths in Kelantan and found family was important. Study C (2023) found cost of living reduced life satisfaction. Study E (2024) examined cash aid.

Masalah: berpusat pengarang, tiada hubungan antara kajian, tiada jurang.Problem: author-centred, no links between studies, no gap.

Tekanan kewangan secara konsisten menjejaskan kesejahteraan psikologi belia B40, sama ada diukur sebagai kemurungan (A, D) atau kepuasan hidup (C). Namun, kesan ini lebih lemah dalam komuniti luar bandar yang mempunyai sokongan keluarga kuat (B, D), dan melemah selepas bantuan tunai (E), menunjukkan peranan penampan yang belum diuji secara kuantitatif dalam konteks luar bandar.Financial stress consistently undermines the psychological well-being of B40 youth, whether measured as depression (A, D) or life satisfaction (C). However, the effect is weaker in rural communities with strong family support (B, D), and weakens after cash aid (E), pointing to buffering roles not yet tested quantitatively in rural settings.

Berpusat konsep · bukti digabung · perbandingan · jurang.Concept-centred · pooled evidence · comparison · gap.

Kajian A–E ialah data latihan rekaan dari Demo 5.Studies A–E are invented training data from Demo 5.

💡
Pro tipPro tipBaca kertas dalam susunan Abstrak → Rajah → Kesimpulan → Kaedah. Dalam 3 minit anda tahu sama ada ia layak dibaca penuh.Read papers in the order Abstract → Figures → Conclusion → Methods. In 3 minutes you know whether it deserves a full read.
Demo 6 · Anda menulis, AI mencabarDemo 6 · You write, AI challenges

Gunakan AI sebagai pengkritik, bukan penulis hantuUse AI as a critic, not a ghostwriter

PROMPT · Claude / Gemini
Anda pemeriksa luar tesis PhD sains sosial.You are an external examiner for a social-science PhD.JANGAN tulis semula perenggan saya.Do NOT rewrite my paragraph.Nilai: (1) dakwaan jelas? (2) bukti digabung? (3) perbandingan? (4) jurang?Assess: (1) clear claim? (2) pooled evidence? (3) comparison? (4) gap?Tandakan setiap ayat yang perlukan sitasi tetapi tiada.Flag every sentence that needs a citation but has none.Akhiri dengan 3 soalan yang pemeriksa akan tanya dalam viva.End with 3 questions an examiner would ask at the viva.
☞Klik baris untuk penerangan.Click a line for its explanation.
Claude
(1) ✗ Tiada dakwaan; perenggan bermula dengan "Kajian A".No claim; the paragraph opens with "Study A".
(2) ✗ Bukti dipersembahkan satu demi satu, tidak digabung.Evidence listed one by one, not pooled.
(3) ! B dan C berbeza konteks (luar bandar/bandar) tetapi tidak dibandingkan.B and C differ in setting (rural/urban) but are not compared.
(4) ✗ Tiada jurang. Kenapa E disebut?No gap. Why is E mentioned?
❓ "Bagaimanakah anda mentakrif B40 secara konsisten merentas kajian A–E?""How do you define B40 consistently across studies A–E?"
PROMPT
Anda penilai jurnal Q1 dalam bidang dasar sosial. Nilai bahagian kajian literatur saya dari segi: kebaharuan jurang, keadilan terhadap bukti bercanggah, dan kesesuaian dengan skop jurnal [nama jurnal]. Beri skor 1–5 dan keputusan: terima / pembetulan kecil / besar / tolak. Jangan tulis semula.You are a Q1 journal reviewer in social policy. Assess my literature review section for: novelty of the gap, fairness to contradicting evidence, and fit with the scope of [journal name]. Score 1–5 and decide: accept / minor / major / reject. Do not rewrite.
Variasi kerumitanComplexity variation

Tambah garis panduan penulis jurnal sebenar sebagai input supaya kritikan mengikut kriteria jurnal itu.Add the journal's real author guidelines as input so critique follows that journal's criteria.

PROMPT
Semak perenggan ini untuk Bahasa Melayu baku (rujuk Tatabahasa Dewan). Senaraikan kesilapan ejaan, imbuhan dan bahasa rojak dalam jadual: asal | cadangan | sebab. Jangan ubah istilah teknikal atau hujah.Check this paragraph for standard Malay (per Tatabahasa Dewan). List spelling, affix and code-mixing errors in a table: original | suggestion | reason. Do not change technical terms or the argument.
VBE

Penyuntingan bahasa ialah penggunaan dibenarkan (Garis Panduan UKM 2.2), tetapi setiap cadangan anda terima atau tolak sendiri.Language editing is a permitted use (UKM Guideline 2.2), but you accept or reject each suggestion yourself.

Tahukah anda? · Mahkamah New York, 2023Did you know? · New York court, 2023

Enam kes mahkamah daripada ChatGPT. Semuanya rekaan.Six court cases from ChatGPT. All invented.

6
kes rekaan dalam hujahaninvented cases in the brief
USD 5,000
denda kepada peguamfine on the lawyers

Dalam Mata lwn. Avianca (S.D.N.Y., Jun 2023), peguam menghantar hujahan yang menyitasi kes rekaan ChatGPT, dan didenda apabila tiada siapa dapat menemuinya.In Mata v. Avianca (S.D.N.Y., June 2023), lawyers filed a brief citing cases ChatGPT invented, and were fined when nobody could find them.

Etika 3.2 · Permainan susun · VBE: IntegritiEthics 3.2 · Sorting game · VBE: Integrity

Boleh ✓ atau Tidak ✗? Ikut Garis Panduan GenAI UKM (2025)Allowed ✓ or Not ✗? Per the UKM GenAI Guideline (2025)

Sumbang saran sinonim kata kunci carianBrainstorm search-keyword synonymsDibenarkan: sumbang saran ialah penggunaan dibenarkan.Allowed: brainstorming is a permissible use.
Jana abstrak artikel untuk menggantikan tulisan sendiriGenerate the article abstract in place of your own writingTidak: Garis Panduan menyenaraikannya sebagai penggunaan tidak dibenarkan.Not allowed: the Guideline lists this as impermissible.
Muat naik transkrip temu bual responden ke chatbot awamUpload respondent interview transcripts to a public chatbotTidak: data sensitif tidak dimasukkan ke alat awam. "Jika ragu, jangan muat naik."Not allowed: no sensitive data in public tools. "When uncertain, do not upload."
Semak tatabahasa perenggan yang anda tulis sendiriProofread a paragraph you wrote yourselfDibenarkan: pembacaan pruf. Semak polisi jurnal sama ada perlu didedahkan.Allowed: proofreading. Check whether the journal requires disclosure.
Sitasi kertas yang dicadangkan AI tanpa membacanyaCite AI-suggested papers without reading themTidak: menyitasi sumber yang belum dibaca dan disahkan adalah dilarang.Not allowed: citing sources you have not read and verified is prohibited.
Senaraikan ChatGPT sebagai pengarang bersamaList ChatGPT as a co-authorTidak: AI tidak boleh menjadi pengarang (UKM; COPE). AI tidak boleh bertanggungjawab.Not allowed: AI cannot be an author (UKM; COPE). AI cannot take responsibility.
Guna NotebookLM untuk ringkaskan artikel akses terbuka, kemudian semak dengan teks asalUse NotebookLM to summarise open-access articles, then check against the originalDibenarkan dengan pengesahan manusia dan pendedahan jika menyumbang kepada hasil.Allowed with human verification and disclosure if it shapes the output.
Jana data sintetik untuk "menambah" sampel yang tidak cukupGenerate synthetic data to "top up" an insufficient sampleTidak: pemalsuan data atau data sintetik tanpa metodologi kukuh dilarang.Not allowed: fabricated or synthetic data without robust methodology is prohibited.

Etika 3.3 · Apa yang boleh dimuat naik?Ethics 3.3 · What may be uploaded?

Sebelum tampal atau muat naik, semak warna data andaBefore you paste or upload, check your data's colour

●

Hijau · bolehGreen · go

  • Artikel akses terbuka (lesen CC)Open-access articles (CC licence)
  • Teks yang anda tulis sendiriText you wrote yourself
  • Rentetan carian, kriteria I/ESearch strings, I/E criteria
●

Kuning · semak dahuluAmber · check first

  • Artikel berlesen langganan PTSL (semak terma penerbit)PTSL subscription articles (check publisher terms)
  • Draf belum terbit milik rakanColleagues' unpublished drafts
  • Bab tesis PhD: perlu kelulusan penyeliaPhD thesis chapters: needs supervisor approval
●

Merah · janganRed · stop

  • Transkrip, rakaman, data respondenTranscripts, recordings, respondent data
  • Maklumat peribadi boleh dikenal pastiPersonally identifiable information
  • Dokumen sulit atau di bawah kelulusan etikaConfidential documents or ethics-restricted data
UKM §2.3

"Jika ragu, jangan muat naik." Guna versi institusi yang selamat (contoh: Gemini dalam Workspace UKM) dan patuhi skop kelulusan etika kajian anda."When uncertain, do not upload." Use secure institutional versions (e.g. Gemini in UKM Workspace) and stay within your study's ethics approval.

AI bukan pengarangAI is not an author

Kemajuan terkini · 2025–2026Recent advancements · 2025–2026

  
Peraturan menjadi lebih jelas; kerja penyelidikan menjadi lebih kolaboratifRules are getting clearer; research work is getting more collaborative

  

    
UKM 2025
5 tahap AI dalam pentaksiran5 AI levels in assessment
Setiap pentaksiran mengisytiharkan tahap 1 (Tiada AI) hingga 5 (Penerokaan AI); kursus memilih Initiation, Integration atau Infusion.Each assessment declares level 1 (No AI) to 5 (AI Exploration); courses choose Initiation, Integration or Infusion.

    
UKM 2025
Pengesan AI bukan buktiDetectors are not proof
Skor pengesan adalah kebarangkalian; tiada keputusan akademik buruk semata-mata berdasarkannya. Simpan prompt dan versi draf sebagai bukti proses.Detector scores are probabilistic; no adverse decision rests on them alone. Keep prompts and drafts as process evidence.

    
Ogos–Sep 2026
Penyelidikan "berbilang pemain""Multiplayer" research
Alat seperti Elicit kini menyokong pustaka dan sesi penyelidikan berkongsi: kumpulan penyeliaan boleh membina asas bukti bersama. Konektivisme dalam produk.Tools like Elicit now support shared libraries and research sessions: supervision groups can build an evidence base together. Connectivism as a product.
